newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig still a buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch & Co Inc said in a report it has reiterated its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian state-owned power firm Cemig.

-- The brokerage said Cemig, which is majority owned by Minas Gerais state, enjoys a strong position as an integrated utility company, "with an attractive location and a comfortable financial position."
-- The company also expects to expand its generation capacity by adding cost-competitive new projects in the future, it said.

-- Increased competition as a result of the sector's deregulation, below-average sales growth and possible frustration in the state's efforts to sell a one-third stake of Cemig voting shares are the firm's main concerns, it added.
-- Cemig preferred was up 0.37 percent at 40.35 reais while its common was off 0.56 percent at 44.50 reais at 1605 local/1905 est on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
